description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Hornet Queen and three Insect tokens, adding {3}{B}.
When Hornet Queen and the Insect tokens die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers four times, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Hornet Queen from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
